6531a67d2504.en: Do suppliers have to pay for I-Cost?

5e23e16ae0f4.en: No. Suppliers and subcontractors use the supplier portal free to receive requests, send prices, accept orders and record deliveries.

4fdae7c60694.en: Can I manage subcontractors in I-Cost?

202188b3b4aa.en: Yes. Subcontractors are added like suppliers: they receive your quotation requests and orders in the free portal and reply there. Your own site labour is tracked through timesheets.

3a39abdba87d.en: Can suppliers see each other's prices?

0b0e4f11f213.en: No. Each supplier only sees their own requests and orders. Only your team sees the side-by-side comparison.

d8c6a5c9c9d7.en: Can I import my existing supplier list?

278ecd135d39.en: Yes. You can import suppliers, and suppliers who already use I-Cost with another company can be added to your list.

e80b792436a1.en: It reads the items in your request and matches them against what each supplier supplies and what you have ordered from them before, then lists the most likely ones first. Your own knowledge only: it never shares your supplier list with anyone.
